subject: Re: Conditional onboarding route for MicroFin Systems — invoice-only vs PO
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@microfin.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20 09:12 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — pilot (MicroFin Systems)

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for taking a look. We're kicking off a 6-week pilot with Redwood's team to validate transaction classification latency and would like to get billing set up. Our procurement team prefers a PO flow, but for speed we wanted to ask if Redwood supports an invoice-only onboarding for trials under $15k.

I've attached our completed vendor intake, W9, and insurance declaration. If invoice-only isn't possible, can you confirm the PO lead time so we can plan?

Attachments: microfin-vendor-intake-form.pdf, W9-MicroFin-Systems.pdf, microfin-insurance-declaration.pdf

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Procurement | MicroFin Systems
elena@microfin.io
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@microfin.io>
Date: 2026-10-20 10:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — pilot (MicroFin Systems)

Marissa / Neha — looping you in for procurement/finance guidance. MicroFin is a US-based fintech startup; pilot spend expected ~ $8k across the trial. They already returned the intake + W9 and insurance.

Ask: Approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding path (no PO) for this pilot, limited to $10k and 90 days. Conditions we can impose: net30 payment terms, required evidence on file, and automatic conversion to PO for any committed spend above threshold.

Elena — will need confirm on billing email and who signs invoices.

Thanks,
Vivek

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-10-20 11:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — pilot (MicroFin Systems)

Thanks Vivek — quick notes from procurement: we can offer a time-limited invoice-only onboarding for small pilots, but need finance sign-off and a risk checklist completed. Requirements:
- Completed vendor intake (attached)
- W9 (attached)
- Liability insurance >= $1M (attached)
- Allocation of spend owner and contact in our system
- Approval cap: $10k without PO; any new invoices that would put total >10k must be escalated to create a PO

Marissa
Sr. Sales Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena@microfin.io>
Date: 2026-10-21 08:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — pilot (MicroFin Systems)

Adding procurement checklist details and one caveat:
1) We need a billing contact and remit-to email in vendor profile (procurement@microfin.io is fine, need a person).
2) Insurance certificate must show effective dates that cover the pilot window.
3) For invoice-only, finance requires an approved authorization PDF (we generate) and we set a 90-day expiry.
4) Region note: MicroFin is US-registered; if they bill from an EU entity later we'll need VAT docs.

If these are confirmed I can kick off vendor creation in Coupa and mark the profile as "Invoice-only pilot" with a $10k cap.

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per procurement: the intake, W9 and insurance look good but we need the insurance to explicitly cover the pilot dates (Oct 25 — Dec 25). Can you confirm an insured period or send an updated cert? Also please provide a primary billing contact (name + email).

Planned next steps/timeline:
- Neha creates vendor record and sets invoice-only pilot flag (by 10/23)
- Finance (Laura) drafts authorization PDF and signs (by 10/25)
- Redwood issues first invoice for pilot services after usage is measured

We will cap at $10k for the pilot, net30. If MicroFin wants to convert to a committed plan or exceeds cap, we'll transition to a PO.

Best,
Vivek

Approved — Finance has reviewed the materials and authorizes a 90-day invoice-only onboarding for MicroFin Systems with a $15,000 cumulative cap. Conditions:
- Authorization valid 2026-10-25 through 2027-01-23
- Net30 payment terms
- Coupa profile to mark "Invoice-only pilot: cap $15k"
- Any single invoice appearing likely to push cumulative spend > $10k must be escalated to Laura for PO conversion prior to payment
